dialogue.sleep.respond.glad: Good. A night's rest is worth having.
dialogue.sleep.rough.respond.empathize: That sounds like a long night.
dialogue.sleep.rough.respond.leave: I'll leave you to wake up properly.
dialogue.sleep.close.share: I've not been sleeping much either.
dialogue.sample_sleep.ordinary/1: Well enough. Woke before the sun and lay there listening to the rain start.
dialogue.sample_sleep.ordinary/2: Fine. I go out about the same time the birds do, so there's not much of the night left over.
dialogue.sample_sleep.ordinary/3: Six hours or so. It's what I'm used to, and it does the job.
dialogue.sample_sleep.again/1: You asked me that not an hour ago. Still slept, still standing.
dialogue.sample_sleep.again/2: Same night it was the last time you asked, %1$s. Nothing has changed since.
dialogue.sample_sleep.again/3: We have done this one already today. I'll not have a better answer by supper.
dialogue.sample_sleep.young/1: I stayed up! Then I fell asleep anyway. On the floor.
dialogue.sample_sleep.young/2: I got woken twice. The second time somebody took the blanket.
dialogue.sample_sleep.young/3: I slept all night and I'm not even tired now. See?
dialogue.sample_sleep.rough/1: Badly. I was awake at every hour that has a name.
dialogue.sample_sleep.rough/2: Not much. The wind got under the shutter and I gave up arguing with it about three.
dialogue.sample_sleep.rough/3: Hardly at all. I kept turning things over that won't be settled by turning them over.
dialogue.sample_sleep.dream/1: Nothing I kept hold of. It's gone by the time my feet hit the floor.
dialogue.sample_sleep.dream/2: Something about counting sacks in a store room. Not worth the telling.
dialogue.sample_sleep.dream/3: Once. Somebody was knocking and I couldn't find the door. That's all I've got.
dialogue.sample_sleep.glad/1: It is. I notice it more the years I get less of it.
dialogue.sample_sleep.glad/2: It's true. A bad night follows you around all day.
dialogue.sample_sleep.glad/3: It is that. Half the arguments in this village are just people who slept poorly.
dialogue.sample_sleep.glad.flat/1: Worth having. Doesn't mean I get it often.
dialogue.sample_sleep.glad.flat/2: So people keep telling me. I'll believe it when I wake up rested.
dialogue.sample_sleep.glad.flat/3: If you say so. I've had rest and I've had days that spoiled it anyway.
dialogue.sample_sleep.rough.empathize/1: It was. Thank you for not telling me to go to bed earlier.
dialogue.sample_sleep.rough.empathize/2: Long enough. It helps to have somebody say so instead of arguing me out of it.
dialogue.sample_sleep.rough.empathize/3: It was, and I'm slow with it today. Kind of you to notice.
dialogue.sample_sleep.rough.ask/1: Money, mostly. It keeps better hours than I do.
dialogue.sample_sleep.rough.ask/2: A noise I never found the source of. I looked twice.
dialogue.sample_sleep.rough.ask/3: Nothing I could point at. That's the worst kind.
dialogue.sample_sleep.rough.brush_off/1: Everyone does. That has never once helped at four in the morning.
dialogue.sample_sleep.rough.brush_off/2: Right. Well. Glad we have settled it.
dialogue.sample_sleep.rough.brush_off/3: Mm. I'll add that to the list of things I've been told today.
dialogue.sample_sleep.leave/1: Go on, then. Nothing here that won't keep.
dialogue.sample_sleep.leave/3: Fine by me. I've the day to start on.
dialogue.sample_sleep.rough.leave/1: Probably for the best. I'm poor company on no sleep.
dialogue.sample_sleep.rough.leave/2: Go on. I'll be better tomorrow, most likely.
dialogue.sample_sleep.rough.leave/3: That's fair. I'd not want to listen to me either today.
dialogue.sample_sleep.close.share/1: Then we're a matched pair. Come find me if you want company at an unreasonable hour.
dialogue.sample_sleep.close.share/2: It's going round, then. Half the street looks like it hasn't slept.
dialogue.sample_sleep.close.share/3: You look it, if you'll forgive me. Take the afternoon off, %1$s.
dialogue.sample_sleep.close.wish/1: I intend to. The shutter is getting fixed first, though.
dialogue.sample_sleep.close.wish/2: That's the plan. I'll not be up past dark if I can help it.
dialogue.sample_sleep.close.wish/3: I'll try. Thank you, %1$s, it's a decent thing to wish somebody.
dialogue.sample_sleep.close.leave/1: Go on, then. I've things waiting on me.
dialogue.sample_sleep.close.leave/2: Off you go. I'll be about the place.
dialogue.sample_sleep.close.leave/3: Later, then. I'm usually somewhere near the well.
